# An unstiffened seated connection: a W16x26 beam bearing on an L6x4x3/4 seat (4 in leg
# outstanding) bolted to the column flange, with a top angle for stability.

design "steel-seated" {
  owner "s.engineer@example.org"
}

seated seat1 {
  basis asd
  beam W16x26 grade steel.A992
  support W10x49 web grade steel.A992
  angle L6x4x1_2 grade steel.A36 outstanding short
  seat_length 7 inch
  setback 0.5 inch
  support_side bolted
  bolts bolt_group.120 diameter 0.5 inch threads included
  rows 2
  pitch 3 inch
  edge_vertical 1.25 inch
  support_gauge 5.5 inch
  top_angle L4x4x1_4 grade steel.A36 outstanding long
}

load task {
  on seat1 shear in [0 kip, 15.843 kip]
  signed "task.owner@example.org" source "task 303-003"
}

# A conventional single-plate shear connection: a W18x50 beam framing into the flange of
# a W14x90 column through a 3/8 in A36 plate, four 3/4 in Group 120 bolts (threads in the
# shear plane), the plate fillet-welded to the column both sides. Coverage demands every
# limit state the kind carries; each is checked over the signed reaction range.

design "steel-shear-tab" {
  owner "s.engineer@example.org"
}

shear_tab st1 {
  basis asd
  beam W18x35 grade steel.A992
  support W10x49 web grade steel.A992
  plate steel.A36 thickness 0.3125 inch
  bolts bolt_group.120 diameter 0.75 inch threads included
  rows 6
  pitch 2.1875 inch
  edge_vertical 1.4375 inch
  plate_edge 1.5 inch
  bolt_line 1.75 inch
  beam_edge 1.75 inch
  top 3 inch
  weld electrode.E70 size 0.25 inch sides 2
}

load task {
  on st1 shear in [0 kip, 45.988 kip]
  signed "task.owner@example.org" source "task 303-006"
}
